# DHL eCommerce Expands to Concord with New Distribution Center and 150 Jobs

DHL eCommerce, a division of DHL Group, has expanded its operations by relocating from Raleigh, NC, to a new 162,836-square-foot distribution center in Concord, NC, near Charlotte Douglas International Airport. This move aims to enhance the company's capacity to process domestic e-commerce shipments for U.S. online merchants. The facility, which began operations on August 18, 2024, features advanced automation, including a single-level loop sorter that processes 24,000 packages per hour—30% more than the previous location. Employing around 150 people, the Concord center is equipped with green initiatives and is set to handle increased shipping volumes in time for the peak holiday season.

Source: Post Consumer Brands, LLC

Jul 31, 2026 By Nicole Kerwin 

ATLANTA — Post Consumer Brands recently received support from the Develop Fulton board of directors, allowing the company to begin an expansion on its existing leased warehouse and distribution facility in Fairburn, Ga., which supports its pet food and cereal brands. Post will collaborate with its current landlord to fund the $31.99 million expansion.

Post plans to add about 301,320 square feet to its existing 700,000-square-foot facility, allowing it to consolidate and expand the distribution of pet foods and breakfast cereal products at the site which will result in a more efficient Southeast distribution hub for the company. The expansion will include a unified warehouse system to improve logistics, reduce transportation costs and strengthen inventory management.
